title: Charges Taken at the Property in a Hotel Rate Plans Departure Balance
content:
Whether the charges a guest took at the property are charged again in the balance settled at departure on a Hotel Rate Plans reservation turns on whether such charges stand on the folio and on whether the rate plan booked includes all meals.

## The rule

1. Where charges taken at the property stand on the folio and the rate plan booked includes all meals, 0 percent of the charges taken at the property is charged, the plan already covering them.
2. Where charges taken at the property stand on the folio and the rate plan booked does not include all meals, 100 percent of them is charged.
3. Where no charge taken at the property stands on the folio, 0 percent is charged.

## Which plans include all meals

| Rate plan | Meals, soft drinks and listed activities all included | Share charged, where such charges stand |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Non-Refundable Saver Rate | no | 100 percent |
| Advance Purchase 21 Rate | no | 100 percent |
| Semi-Flexible Rate | no | 100 percent |
| Standard Flexible Rate | no | 100 percent |
| Member Flex Rate | no | 100 percent |
| Suite Flexible Rate | no | 100 percent |
| All-Inclusive Flex Rate | yes | 0 percent |

## Worked on hypothetical figures

Charges taken at the property of 85.00 USD standing on the folio:

- On the Standard Flexible Rate, 100 percent is charged, being 85.00 USD.
- On the All-Inclusive Flex Rate, 0 percent is charged, being 0.00 USD.
- Where no such charge stood on the folio, nothing would be charged on either plan.
